newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Home to redeem remaining convertible pfd.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Home to redeem remaining convertible pfd.

text.p: U.S. Home Corp said Wednesday its board has authorized the redemption of the remaining outstanding shares of the company's convertible redeemable preferred stock for $25 a share on March 18, 1997.
The company said it has currently 116,824 shares outstanding of the stock.
It said the certificates representing the preferred shares must be surrendered for payment of the redemption price to First Chicago Trust Company of New York.
The preferred shares may be converted into common stock of U.S. Home until the close of business on March 17, 1997 at the conversion ratio of one common share for each prefered share, it said.
